records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2024, increased by $2.2 billion, or 10%, compared to the year ended December 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: TIDAL primarily generates revenue from subscriptions to customers, and such subscriptions allow access to the song library, video library, and improved sound quality.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Cash App generated gross profit of $5.2 billion in 2024, up 21% year over year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: This increase for the year ended December 31, 2024 was driven by an increase in the average market price of bitcoin, partially offset by a decrease in the quantity of bitcoin sold to customers, compared to the year ended December 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2024, operating income was $892.3 million and Adjusted Operating Income was $1.6 billion, compared to an operating loss of $278.8 million and Adjusted Operating Income of $351.4 million in 2023.
